Boubyan Brokerage (GTN) App is a new mobile application that allows existing Brokerage customers to trade in seven different regional markets (Kuwait, Saudi, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman, and UAE) using their iOS smartphones.

Customers can place buy and sell orders in all seven markets in an easy and interactive way. They can also view real-time market data and customize their own watch-lists to subscribed markets through the App. 

Product/Service

A new mobile application that allows existing Brokerage customers to trade in seven markets that are currently offered through Boubyan Brokerage (GTN) App, in addition to the following features:
 
• View/amend/cancel orders 
• View portfolio details and account summary 
• Instant market quotes, charts, and information (please refer to the Prices & Fees table) 
• Latest news and announcements (please refer to the Prices & Fees table) 
• Customization and management of watch-lists
• Setting stock-specific alerts
• Easy to use, trade, search, and navigate
